tasks.short: Run laboratory tests and file the raw reading

steps.what: Conduct chemical or physical laboratory tests on solids, liquids and gaseous materials
Draft the reading to assist scientists making qualitative or quantitative analyses
File reading v1 in the laboratory record {OTHER}

tasks.design: She still conducts every chemical or physical test at the bench, drafts the raw reading, and files reading v1 into the laboratory record {OTHER}. Nothing lists samples, drafts a released analysis, or sends a result.
tasks.previous_blocker: The test is physical work on a sample and the reading is her observation.
tasks.enabler_now: No tool is added, because the bench test still needs her.
tasks.still_hard: A wrong method or a contaminated sample is still hers to notice.
tasks.human_edge: She runs the test and stands behind the reading.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still conducts every test, drafts the reading, and files reading v1.

reach.task: Use the raw reading in the qualitative or quantitative analysis
reach.learn: Read reading v1 before asking for the test to be repeated.

evidence.claim: Running a chemical or physical laboratory test on a sample stays with the person at the bench. This is model knowledge.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
She drafts the reading and then files reading v1 herself. The draft is not the standing record. Chemists are inside the organisation, so the file stays write_internal.
The bench test does not write a record, so that step stays read and ungated.
This task does not list samples, draft an analysis for release, raise an alert, or send a result.
Reading v1 is the raw reading. It is not the released compilation, which is a different task. This design does not publish a result outside the organisation.
unknowns: How long a given test takes on the bench is unknown, and this design does not shorten it.
research_questions: On a week of tests, how often is the raw reading written as separate fields rather than a sentence?

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Both ends are zero. She still conducts the test, drafts the reading, and files reading v1, and no tool is added.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Read quality results, compare limits, and file the decision

steps.what: Monitor product quality by reading standards in {OTHER}
Compare the result to specifications in the {OTHER} record
Decide compliance to ensure standards after checking the comparison meaning
File compliance decision v1 in the {OTHER} record

tasks.design: She still reads every result and the standards in the laboratory record {OTHER}. Today she compares the measured value with the specification limits herself. In the future, when those values are already separate fields, that comparison is prepared for her and she no longer does it by hand. She still decides compliance and files compliance decision v1 herself. The comparison is unsaved, is not a certificate, and is not sent. Nothing lists batches or raises an alert.
tasks.previous_blocker: The result and the limits often sit in prose, so a comparison cannot decide compliance.
tasks.enabler_now: When the measured value and the specification limits are separate fields, ordinary code can compare them.
tasks.still_hard: A result near a limit, a changed method, or a unit mismatch still needs her judgement.
tasks.human_edge: She decides whether the batch complies.
tasks.altitude: She still reads every result and decides compliance. She no longer compares a written number with written limits by hand when those fields are present.

reach.task: Use the compliance decision on the batch
reach.learn: Read compliance decision v1 and do not treat an unsaved comparison as the decision.

evidence.claim: Comparing one stored number with a stored low and a high is a fixed rule and does not decide compliance. This is model knowledge.

assumptions: Checking the comparison sits entirely in the compliance decision she already makes, so the upkeep allowance on top of that is zero. Specification upkeep sits outside this task.
Today she compares the result with the specification herself, so the baseline actor on that step stays the chemical technician. The machine is only the future of that comparison.

The comparison runs only when measured_value, result_unit, spec_low, spec_high and spec_unit are already separate fields on the laboratory record {OTHER}. The chemical technician writes measured_value and result_unit on the laboratory-test task. That capture sits outside this task and is not counted as saved. The chemist writes spec_low, spec_high and spec_unit beforehand. If any field is missing or the units differ, the comparison does not run and she compares by hand.

The comparison is an unsaved note. It is not written into the standing record, it is not the compliance decision, and it is not a certificate. She checks what the comparison means against the result she read, not only that two numbers match.
She files compliance decision v1 herself. Quality control analysts and chemists are inside the organisation, so the file stays write_internal.
Nothing lists batches, raises an alert, generates a certificate, or sends a result.
The 12-point share is one number against a written low and a high on a batch she has already read. It is not measured minutes.
unknowns: How often the measured value, the unit and the specification limits are already separate fields is unknown.
research_questions: On a week of batches, how often is the comparison a single number against a written low and a high, and how often is the limit written only in prose?

incremental.description: No separate upkeep, because checking the comparison sits entirely in the compliance decision she already makes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The task gives no minute split. Low is a batch where a field is missing or the units differ, so she compares by hand and the check does not run. High is a batch where the measured value and the limits are already written and only that numeric comparison drops. She still reads every result and still decides compliance.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Set up methods and run the chemical experiments

steps.what: Set up chromatography, spectroscopy, physical or chemical separation techniques, or microscopy
Conduct the chemical experiments, tests and analyses using those techniques

tasks.design: She sets up chromatography, spectroscopy, separation or microscopy herself and conducts the experiment at the bench. She does not file a standing result here. Nothing lists methods, drafts a procedure, raises an alert, or sends a report.
tasks.previous_blocker: The setup and the run are physical work on this sample and this method.
tasks.enabler_now: No tool is added, because the experiment still needs her at the bench.
tasks.still_hard: A method that cannot show what the chemist asked is still hers to notice.
tasks.human_edge: She sets up the method and runs the experiment.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still sets up every method and still runs every experiment.

reach.task: Use the completed experiment in the study
reach.learn: Treat the setup and the run as her work, and ask what the method cannot show.

evidence.claim: Setting up chromatography, spectroscopy, separation or microscopy, and running the experiment, stays with the person at the bench. This is model knowledge.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
She does not file a standing reading here. Filing reading v1 sits on the laboratory-test task and is not counted as saved here.
Setting up and running the instrument does not write a record, so both steps stay read and ungated.
This task does not list methods, draft a procedure, raise an alert, or send a report.
unknowns: How often the method is chromatography, spectroscopy, separation or microscopy is unknown.
research_questions: On a week of experiments, how much of the time is setup and how much is the run?

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Both ends are zero. She still sets up the method and still runs the experiment, and no tool is added.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Read test results, compile them, and file the interpretation

steps.what: Read results of tests and analyses in {OTHER}
Compile results from the laboratory record {OTHER}
Interpret what the compiled results of those tests and analyses mean
File interpretation v1 in the laboratory record {OTHER}

tasks.design: She still opens and reads every result in the laboratory record {OTHER}. Today she copies test name, value and unit into one place herself. In the future, when those fields are already written, that compilation is prepared for her and she no longer copies them by hand. She still interprets the results and files interpretation v1 herself. The compilation is unsaved and is not sent. Nothing lists results in place of reading, raises an alert, or drafts the interpretation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Readings were copied by hand because they were not stored as separate fields.
tasks.enabler_now: A fixed join can assemble fields that are already written.
tasks.still_hard: Saying what the results mean, and spotting a number that cannot be right, stays with her.
tasks.human_edge: She interprets the results. The compilation does not.
tasks.altitude: She still reads every reading and still interprets the results. She no longer copies already written test name, value and unit into one place by hand.

reach.task: Use the interpretation of the test results
reach.learn: Read interpretation v1 and do not treat the unsaved compilation as the finding.

evidence.claim: Assembling a stored test name, value and unit into one compilation is a fixed join. Interpreting what the numbers mean is not. This is model knowledge.

assumptions: Checking the compiled numbers sits entirely in the interpretation she already does, so the upkeep allowance on top of that is zero.
Today she compiles the results herself, so the baseline actor on that step stays the chemical technician. The machine is only the future of that assembly.

The compilation is built only from readings that already have test_name, measured_value and result_unit on the laboratory record {OTHER}. She writes those fields on the laboratory-test task. That capture sits outside this task and is not counted as saved. A reading that lacks a field is left blank and she compiles that reading by hand.
The compilation is not filed and is not sent. She checks each compiled number against the reading she read, and she states what the results mean. She files interpretation v1 herself.
Nothing lists results in place of reading, raises an alert, sends a result, generates a certificate, or drafts the interpretation.
unknowns: How often a reading lacks a test name, a value or a unit is unknown.
research_questions: On a week of compilations, how many readings are copied by hand because a field is missing?

incremental.description: No separate upkeep, because checking the compiled numbers sits entirely in the interpretation she already does.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The task gives no minute split. Low is a set of readings where any reading lacks a field, so she compiles by hand and the assembly does not run. High is a set where every reading already has test name, value and unit, and only that assembly drops. She still reads every result and still interprets them.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The week is unchanged on the bench. She still runs every test, sets up every method, reads every result, and decides compliance and meaning. When the measured value and the specification limits are already written, she no longer compares those two numbers by hand. When each reading already has a test name, value and unit, she no longer copies them into one place by hand.
reach: A chemist uses reading v1 and does not rerun the test.
A chemist uses the completed experiment and does not repeat the setup.
A quality control analyst uses compliance decision v1 and does not remeasure the batch.
A chemist uses interpretation v1 and does not reinterpret the same readings.
skills_to_grow: Run the chemical or physical test at the bench before relying on a reading.
Decide compliance only after reading the result, including when a comparison is present.
Interpret the results herself before the finding is filed.
role.ambitious_version: She uses the time no longer spent copying numbers to look again at results that sit near a specification limit.
